parameters.query: SELECT id, role, active FROM users WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;

parameters.jsCode:
const requester = $input.first().json;
const c = $('Parse Token & Payload').first().json;

if (!requester.id || !requester.active) throw new Error('Invalid session.');

const sqlQuery = `
  UPDATE contacts SET
    first_name      = COALESCE(NULLIF($1, ''), first_name),
    last_name       = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), last_name),
    job_title       = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), job_title),
    account_id      = COALESCE($4, account_id),
    email           = COALESCE(NULLIF($5, ''), email),
    secondary_email = COALESCE(NULLIF($6, ''), secondary_email),
    phone           = COALESCE(NULLIF($7, ''), phone),
    secondary_phone = COALESCE(NULLIF($8, ''), secondary_phone),
    linkedin_url    = COALESCE(NULLIF($9, ''), linkedin_url),
    lead_status     = COALESCE(NULLIF($10, ''), lead_status),
    lead_source     = COALESCE(NULLIF($11, ''), lead_source),
    city            = COALESCE(NULLIF($12, ''), city),
    state           = COALESCE(NULLIF($13, ''), state),
    zip_code        = COALESCE(NULLIF($14, ''), zip_code),
    country         = COALESCE(NULLIF($15, ''), country),
    do_not_contact  = COALESCE($16, do_not_contact),
    updated_at      = NOW()
  WHERE id = $17 AND ($18 = 'admin' OR owner_id = $19)
  RETURNING *;
`;

const queryParams = [
  c.first_name, c.last_name, c.job_title, c.account_id,
  c.email, c.secondary_email, c.phone, c.secondary_phone, c.linkedin_url,
  c.lead_status, c.lead_source,
  c.city, c.state, c.zip_code, c.country,
  c.do_not_contact,
  c.contactId, requester.role, requester.id
];

return [{ json: { sqlQuery, queryParams } }];
